ledger.founder.why: the founder ledger's rules and its append command, run by a session and by test 14 (tests/test_founder_ledger.py); the loop never writes founder rows

profile.fit.why: a session composes each unit candidate's recipe from its own npm scripts and judges it with unit_verify.check_recipe; its --units output is targets/<target>/units.json, which loop.cek reads; run by a session and by test 47 (tests/test_profile_fit.py)

profile.jsimports.why: the one reader of a JS/TS tree's references (walk, import specifiers, tsconfig extends and path aliases, a bare specifier's package), read by status.depmap and profile.fit (session tools) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_jsimports.py, tests/test_profile_fit.py)

profile.nx.why: an Nx project's lint and test targets as the commands their executors run, read by profile.fit (a session tool) only; run by a session and by test 47 (tests/test_profile_nx.py)

profile.pypath.why: the directories a Python file puts on sys.path, read statically, read by status.depmap (a session tool) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_pypath.py)

status.depmap.why: the dependency drawings, run in a session and by test 42; the loop never runs it

status.exit_b.why: the exit audit of asama-0/10a against harness.pass_row and the generated docs/exit-b.md, run by a session (python tests/test_rehearsal.py --doc) and by test 45 (tests/test_exit_b.py, tests/test_rehearsal.py); the loop never runs it
